newsitem.title: DUBAI: Omani shares end the week broadly steady.
newsitem.headline: Omani shares end the week broadly steady.

text.p: Shares on Oman's stock exchange were mostly steady in the week to Wednesday in trade dominated by industrials, the bourse said.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index closed slightly lower at 186.31 points from 187.33 the previous week.
Of the 58 companies traded in the week, prices of 22 rose, 22 fell and 14 were steady.
Industrials accounted for 53 percent of total trading value, followed by banking and investment sector shares with 34 percent. Services stocks represented 11 percent of value traded.
It was another week of gains for heavyweight Oman National Holding Co, with 120,000 shares worth some 496,000 rials changing hands.
The share closed at 4.120 rials from 4.110 last week.
Some 164,000 Oman Textile Mills stocks worth 484,000 rials were traded in the week. It closed lower at 2.970 rials from a previous 2.980.
